Knee sprain. [DATE].

Findings:

Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Marginal amputation of the body of the lateral meniscus. Medial meniscus with preserved morphology and signal, no signs of tear.
Cartilage of the femorotibial compartments without alterations.

Mild joint effusion. No pathological popliteal cysts.
Increased signal at the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and at the proximal insertion of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear.

Focal grade 4 chondropathy of the inferior aspect of the medial facet of the femoral trochlea.
Reparative chondral phenomena of the central region of the femoral trochlea.
Mild joint effusion.
Mild distal quadriceps and proximal patellar tendinosis.

Report_en:
Clinical History:
Acute traumatic knee.
Findings:
Full-thickness and full-width tear at the junction of the middle third and proximal third of the ACL, associated with mild bone edema of the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau. PCL and collateral ligaments without significant abnormalities.
Increased central signal of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus that does not appear to contact the articular surface, without features of a tear.
Lateral meniscus with a small incomplete radial tear at the junction of the posterior horn and body, without displacement of segments.
Full-thickness chondral ulceration of the weight-bearing zone of the lateral femoral condyle measuring approximately 6 x 5 mm in its mediolateral and anteroposterior axes, without secondary bone changes. Thin focal full-thickness chondral ulceration of the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau. The remaining femorotibial and patellofemoral cartilages without abnormalities.
Mild to moderate joint effusion, probably hemarthrosis. Small amount of intermuscular fluid in the popliteal region.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Impression:
Full-thickness and full-width tear of the ACL.
Incomplete radial tear at the junction of the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus.
Chondropathy grade 3 lesions of the lateral femorotibial compartment, as previously described.
Mild to moderate joint effusion, probably hemarthrosis.

Report_en:
TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
- In the medial compartment, a degenerative tear is observed in the posterior horn and body of the meniscus. Additionally, mild bone marrow edema and complete loss of articular cartilage (ICRS Grade IV) are noted on the medial tibial condyle, while small marginal osteophytes coexist on the femoral and tibial condyles.
- On evaluation of the lateral compartment, mild bone marrow edema is observed on the lateral tibial condyle.
- On evaluation of the anterior compartment, no pathological findings are noted.
- The collateral and cruciate ligaments appear normal.
- A moderate amount of intra-articular fluid is observed, associated with a large multiloculated Baker's cyst measuring 9.7 cm in craniocaudal diameter adjacent to the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle.

CONCLUSION
1. Degenerative osteoarthritis and degenerative meniscal tear in the medial compartment.
2. Microtrabecular insufficiency fractures (synonymous with SONK) of the medial tibial condyle and to a lesser extent the anterolateral tibial condyle. No depression of the articular surface is observed.

Report: МР находка: МР данни за фрактура на тибията в областта на интеркондиларните еминенции. Фрактурата е без данни за значима дислокация. Хрущялът, покриващ ставните повърхности на костите е съхранен. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Нормално представени менискуси. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – нормално представени. Заключение:  МР данни за фрактура на тибията в областта на интеркондиларните еминенции, без значима дислокация. Контузионен костномозъчен едем. Минимален ставен излив.
Report_en: MRI findings: MRI evidence of fracture of the tibia in the region of the intercondylar eminences. The fracture shows no evidence of significant displacement. Contusion bone marrow edema is visualized in the tibia centrally and towards the medial tibial plateau. Minimal subchondral edema is also depicted on the medial surface of the patella. The cartilage covering the articular surfaces of the bones is preserved. The cruciate ligaments are intact. The menisci are normal. Patellar cartilage, retinacula – normal. Insall-Salvati ratio – 1.3. Normal depiction of the patellar tendon and the quadriceps femoris tendon. Presence of minimal joint effusion. Conclusion: MRI evidence of fracture of the tibia in the region of the intercondylar eminences, without significant displacement. Contusion bone marrow edema. Minimal joint effusion.

Report_en:
[DATE]: MR Knee Right 15ch
AA: Clinical information: See scanned request. Diagnostic question: See scanned request.
Findings:
Advanced lateral femorotibial cartilage damage with complete cartilage loss anteriorly, centrally and posteriorly in the weight-bearing area of the lateral tibial plateau, accompanied by marginal osteophytosis, limited subchondral bone changes. Degenerative appearance of the lateral meniscus with swelling of the body, which is located outside the joint space. Further swelling of the suprapatellar recess, with numerous thickenings of the synovium, nodular beginning to moderate femoropatellar cartilage damage with multiple fissures. Moderate medial femorotibial cartilage damage, with quasi complete cartilage loss in the weight-bearing area of the medial femoral condyle, extensive marginal osteophytosis. Advanced mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, with swollen appearance and increased T2 signal. Popliteal cyst, with limited fluid infiltration superficial to the medial gastrocnemius muscle.
Conclusion:
Advanced gonarthrosis of the right knee, currently with hydrops, chronic synovitis, advanced mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, recent rupture of popliteal cyst, however without significant bone edema.

Report_en:
Clinical History:
Left knee pain.
Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Partial cystic transformation of the proximal third of the ACL. PCL and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Increased central signal of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus contacting the inferior articular surface, suggesting a tear.
Tear of the anterior horn, body, and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with minimal extrusion. This is associated with regional soft tissue edema.
Partial and full-thickness chondral ulcers of the central region of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femoral condyle. Partial-thickness chondral ulcers of the central region of the lateral tibial plateau. Superficial chondropathy of the remaining femorotibial cartilages and of the femoral trochlea.
Full-thickness chondral ulcers with diffuse distribution of the patella.
Mild joint effusion with mild synovitis. No popliteal cysts.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserinus tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Impression:
Signs of a medial meniscus tear, non-displaced.
Complex tear of the anterior horn, body, and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with minimal extrusion and regional soft tissue edema.
Chondropathy grade 3 lesions of the central region of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femoral condyle and of the lateral tibial plateau.
Superficial chondropathy of the remaining femorotibial compartments.
Chondropathy grade 2 and 3 lesions of the patella.
Mild joint effusion with mild diffuse synovitis.

Report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Lateral femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyinin anteriyor yarısındaki subkondral kırığı kemik iliği ödemi çevreliyor. Tibyal plato posterolateral köşesinde pivot kayması ile ilintili kemik kontüzyonu mevcut. Ön çapraz bağdaki laksite artışı ve ödem yüksek olasılıkla tam kat-tam kata yakın yırtık ile birlikte. Posteriyor oblik ve oblik popliteal bağlar ödemli ancak menisküs yırtığı eşlik etmiyor. Posteriyor medyal köşe yapıları bunların dışında korunmuş. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral köşe yapıları korunmuş. Medyal menisküs ve lateral menisküs normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunların dışında normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).
Report_en: Mild increase in intra-articular fluid. Bone marrow edema surrounding a subchondral fracture in the anterior half of the weight-bearing surface of the lateral femoral condyle. Bone contusion in the posterolateral corner of the tibial plateau, consistent with pivot shift. Increased laxity and edema in the anterior cruciate ligament, most likely associated with a full-thickness or near full-thickness tear. The posterior oblique and oblique popliteal ligaments are edematous but no meniscal tear is associated. The posterior medial corner structures are otherwise preserved. The posterior cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. The posterolateral corner structures are preserved. The medial meniscus and lateral meniscus are normal. The articular cartilage and bones are otherwise normal. The extensor mechanism is preserved (quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon, patella and its position, femoral trochlear groove and patellofemoral ligaments are normal).

Report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial ve lateral  menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptüre sekonder bütünlük kaybı izlenmiştir. Medial kollateral ligamende incelme ve periligamentöz ödem izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Femur lateral kondilde subartiküler nondeplase fraktür ve komşu kemik iliğinde ödem izlenmiştir.Tibia lateral plato posteriorunda fibula başında kontüzyonel kemik iliği ödemleri izlenmektedir.Tibianın tibiafemoral eklemden hafif anteriora doğru subluksasyonu izlenmiştir.Soleus kası proksimal kesimde kas dokuda STIR sekans ödeme bağlı sinyal artışı, kas basısında sıvı artışı mevcuttur.SONUÇ:Anterior çapraz bağ komplet rüptürü.Tibia ve femurda kissing kontüzyon ve femurda subartiküler fraktür.Tibianın anteriora hafif subluksasyonu.Medial ve lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati.Medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain.Suprapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde hafif sinovit.Soleus kasında grade I strain .
Report_en:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: Grade II degeneration is observed in the posterior horn and body of the medial and lateral meniscus. The posterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament are normal. Loss of integrity secondary to complete rupture is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. Thinning and periligamentous edema are observed in the medial collateral ligament. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Increased fluid is observed in the suprapatellar bursa and knee joint space. A subarticular nondisplaced fracture and edema in the adjacent bone marrow are observed in the lateral femoral condyle. Contusional bone marrow edema is observed in the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau and in the fibular head. Mild anterior subluxation of the tibia from the tibiofemoral joint is observed. Signal increase due to edema on STIR sequence in the muscle tissue at the proximal portion of the soleus muscle, and increased fluid at the muscle belly is present.
CONCLUSION:
Complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament.
Kissing contusion in the tibia and femur and subarticular fracture in the femur.
Mild anterior subluxation of the tibia.
Grade II meniscopathy in the medial and lateral meniscus.
Grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament.
Suprapatellar bursitis, mild synovitis in the knee joint.
Grade I strain of the soleus muscle.

Μικρή συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται ενδαρθρικά σε επικοινωνία µε µικρή συνοβιακή κύστη Baker.
Report_en:
MRI RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, T2 gradient echo, and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS
No significant findings are observed on evaluation of the cruciate and collateral ligaments.
Simple degeneration is observed in the lateral meniscus.
Degeneration and mild subluxation are observed in the medial meniscus.
In the medial compartment, additionally, mild subarticular bone marrow edema of the medial femoral condyle and focal erosion of the articular cartilage of the medial femoral condyle at the weight-bearing axis (ICRS grade II) are observed.
Bone marrow edema is barely recognizable in the distal femoral epiphysis and the proximal tibial epiphysis.
Fluid collection is observed intra-articularly with focal thickening of the synovium.
No significant findings are observed on evaluation of the extensor mechanism.

IMPRESSION:
Findings of early degenerative osteoarthritis in the medial compartment.

In the region of the lateral femoral condyle, anterior to the insertion of the popliteus tendon, there is also a depressed bone contour over an area of approximately 9 mm in diameter, which may correspond to an impaction fracture. Extensive surrounding bone marrow edema.
Thickening and edema of the medial patellar retinaculum with discontinuity of fibers in the central portion consistent with rupture. A small amount of effusion suprapatellarly and in the medial recess with a more prominent suprapatellar fat pad.

Grade 1 chondromalacic changes of the cartilage of the medial patellar facet.

Early enthesopathic changes at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon and at the patellar insertion of the patellar ligament.
Complete suprapatellar plica.

The posterior cruciate ligament shows normal signal intensity and intact continuity.
Linear hyperintensity in the red zone of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, which may correspond to a vascular structure, without evident tear.
The lateral meniscus shows normal signal intensity, without signs of tear.
The medial collateral ligament shows normal signal intensity and intact continuity.
Enthesopathic changes at the proximal insertion of the lateral collateral ligament.
Enthesopathic changes and minor bursitis of the popliteus tendon.
Normal appearance of the iliotibial tract and pes anserinus.
Baker's cyst measuring approximately 22x12x27 mm (APxLLxCC).

МР находка: МР данни за фрактура в областта на латералното тибиално плато, без дислокация. Наличие на костно-мозъчен едем около фрактурата. Контузионен костно-мозъчен едем се визуализира и в латералния феморален кондил. МР данни за руптура на предната кръстна връзка. На топичното място на връзката се вижда зона на патологично променен сигнален интензитет, съответстваща на дезорганизирани съединително-тъканни влакна, оток и кръв. Хеморагичен излив в ставата. МР данни за MPFL лезия – скъсване на медиалния поплите-феморален лигамент. Скъсването на лигамента е на залавното му към фемура място. Задна кръстна връзка – без особености.  Менискуси – без особености. Ставният хрущял е интактен. Сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Оток на меките тъкани около коляното.
Заключение:  МР данни за фрактура без дислокация в областта на латералното тибиално плато. Скъсване на предната кръста връзка. MPFL лезия.  Ставен излив.
Report_en:
MRI findings: MRI findings of a fracture in the region of the lateral tibial plateau, without displacement. Presence of bone marrow edema around the fracture. Contusion-type bone marrow edema is also visualized in the lateral femoral condyle. MRI findings of rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament. At the anatomic location of the ligament, a zone of pathologically altered signal intensity is seen, corresponding to disorganized connective tissue fibers, edema, and blood. Hemorrhagic joint effusion. MRI findings of MPFL lesion – tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament. The ligament tear is at its femoral attachment site. Posterior cruciate ligament – unremarkable. Menisci – unremarkable. The articular cartilage is intact. Quadriceps femoris tendon and patellar ligament – normal appearance. Soft tissue edema around the knee.
Conclusion: MRI findings of a non-displaced fracture in the region of the lateral tibial plateau. Tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. MPFL lesion. Joint effusion.

Lateralni menisk bez znakova rupture blaže degenerativno promijenjen u prednjem rogu i
prednjem korijenu.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog

Burzitis tetive popliteusa.
Uredan prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Entezopatske promjene tetive kvadricepsa.
Patelarni ligament su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Inkompletna suprapatelarna plica.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Manja količina izljeva u zglob.
Baker cista veličine 22x31x37 mm (apxllxcc).
Report_en:
Bone marrow edema of the medial femoral condyle, the anterior part of the medial tibial condyle, and the lateral tubercle of the intercondylar eminence of the tibia.
Given the erosive changes of the articular cartilage of the medial compartment of the femorotibial joint, described as likely in the setting of OA changes.
Chondromalacia grade II of the cartilage of the lateral tibial plateau and chondromalacia grade I of the lateral facet of the patella.
The visualized joint bodies are appropriately articulated.
The anterior cruciate ligament is of intact continuity, moderately to severely degenerative.
The posterior cruciate ligament is of appropriate signal intensity and intact continuity.
Degeneratively changed medial meniscus, particularly in the region of the body and posterior horn where a complex tear with radial and horizontal components extending toward the femoral surface is seen.
The lateral meniscus shows no signs of tear, mildly degenerative in the anterior horn and anterior root.
The lateral and medial collateral ligaments are of appropriate signal intensity, intact continuity.
Bursitis of the popliteus tendon.
Normal appearance of the iliotibial tract and pes anserinus.
Enthesopathic changes of the quadriceps tendon.
The patellar ligament is of appropriate signal intensity, intact continuity.
Incomplete suprapatellar plica.
The patellar retinacula are intact.
Small amount of joint effusion.
Baker's cyst measuring 22x31x37 mm (AP x LL x CC).

Report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs posterior hornda radial yırtık hattı izlenmiştir.Lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon saptanmıştır. PCL hafif elonge görünümdedir, sinyal bütünlüğü korunmuştur. ACL'de parsiyel rüptürü düşündüren devamsızlık, trasesinde sinyal-kalınlık artışı izlenmiştir. Lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursada, diz eklem kapsülünde artmış efüzyon mevcuttur.
Report_en:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: A radial tear line is observed in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Grade II degeneration is detected in the lateral meniscus. The PCL appears slightly elongated; signal integrity is preserved. Discontinuity suggesting partial rupture is observed in the ACL, with increased signal and thickness along its course. The lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Increased effusion is present in the suprapatellar bursa and the knee joint capsule.

Report_en: Technique: Knee MRI. Results: Hoffa's fat pad impingement. Iliotibial band friction syndrome. Patellar chondropathy. Impression: Hoffa's fat pad impingement. Iliotibial band friction syndrome. Patellar chondropathy.

Report: T2-hyperintense lineare radiale Läsion der Pars intermedia des Innenmeniskus mit inkompletter Separation eines kleinen Lappens (3/7, 5/109-110). Die initial extruierte Pars intermedia des Innenmeniskus im Corpusbereich mukoid aufgefasert. Weitere zarte horizontale T2-Hyperintensität im Innenmeniskushinterhorn (3/7, 4/20). Fokal T2-hyperintenses Signal im medialen Tibiaplateau (7/22). Flüssigkeitssignal ums MCL. VKB, HKB, MCL und LCL intakt und physiologisch signalgebend. Kleine zystoide Veränderungen an den Insertionsstellen des VKB. Geringer Gelenkerguss. Baker-Zyste; diese bis 2 x 1,5 x CC 3,5 cm Ausdehnung.
Report_en: T2-hyperintense linear radial lesion of the intermediate portion of the medial meniscus with incomplete separation of a small flap (3/7, 5/109-110). The initially extruded intermediate portion of the medial meniscus is mucoid frayed in the body region. Additional subtle horizontal T2 hyperintensity in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus (3/7, 4/20). Focal T2-hyperintense signal in the medial tibial plateau (7/22). Fluid signal around the MCL. ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL intact and with physiological signal. Small cystoid changes at the insertion sites of the ACL. Mild joint effusion. Baker's cyst; measuring up to 2 x 1.5 x 3.5 cm (CC) in extent.

Report:
МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив. Изобразява се остеохондрална фрактура в областта на медиалния кондил на бедрената кост. Фрактурата се представя като хипоинтензна линия с дъговидна форма. Налице е костно-мозъчен едем в костта, както и депресия на медиалното плато. В този участък се изобразява и изтъняване на артикулиращия хрущял на кондила на протежение от около 9 мм. Костно-мозъчен едем е налице в медиалното тибиално плато, както и в отграничен участък от латералния кондил на фемура. Ставният хрущял, покриващ тибията и латералния кондил на бедрената кост, е със запазена дебелина и конгруентност.
МР данни за руптура на задния рог на медиалния менискус. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с кос ход, достигаща до края на менискуса и до артикулиращата повърхност на тибията. МР данни за дегенеративни промени в задния рог на латералния менискус. В него се вижда къса хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, не достигаща до ставните повърхности. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус и на 
предния рог на латералния менискус. Латералният менискус е лекостепенно експулсиран встрани. МР данни за пълна руптура на предната кръстна връзка в залавното ѝ място за фемура. Връзката е с разширен напречник и е с дифузно повишен сигнален интензитет. Задна кръстна връзка – интактна. Двата колатерални лигамента са с правилна форма, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет до залавните им места. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на m. quadriceps femoris, lig. patellae – нормален образ. Изобразени мускулни групи и останали меки тъкани – нормален образ. Наличие на малка еднокамерна Бекерова киста в поплитеалната ямка с размер 17/12 мм. Заключение: МР данни за остеохондрална фрактура в медиалното плато на бедрената кост. Скъсване в заден рог на медиален менискус - grade 3. Лезия в задния рог на латералния менискус – grade 2a. Пълна руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Ставен излив. Травматичен костно-мозъчен едем. Малка Бекерова киста.
Report_en:
MR findings: MR evidence of joint effusion. An osteochondral fracture is visualized in the region of the medial femoral condyle. The fracture presents as a hypointense line with an arcuate shape. Bone marrow edema is present in the bone, as well as depression of the medial plateau. In this area, thinning of the articular cartilage of the condyle is also visualized over a length of approximately 9 mm. Bone marrow edema is present in the medial tibial plateau, as well as in a circumscribed area of the lateral femoral condyle. The articular cartilage covering the tibia and the lateral femoral condyle is of preserved thickness and congruence.
MR evidence of rupture of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. In the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, a hyperintense line with an oblique course is visualized, reaching the edge of the meniscus and the articular surface of the tibia. MR evidence of degenerative changes in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. Within it, a short hyperintense line with a horizontal course is seen, not reaching the articular surfaces. Normal appearance of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus and of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. The lateral meniscus is mildly extruded laterally. MR evidence of complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament at its femoral attachment. The ligament is of widened diameter and shows diffusely increased signal intensity. Posterior cruciate ligament – intact. Both collateral ligaments are of normal shape, homogeneous structure, and signal intensity up to their attachments. Patella, patellar cartilage, retinacula – unremarkable. Quadriceps femoris tendon, patellar ligament – normal appearance. Visualized muscle groups and remaining soft tissues – normal appearance. Presence of a small unilocular Baker's cyst in the popliteal fossa measuring 17/12 mm.
Conclusion: MR evidence of osteochondral fracture of the medial femoral plateau. Tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3. Lesion of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus – grade 2a. Complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament. Joint effusion. Traumatic bone marrow edema. Small Baker's cyst.

Report:
Zglobna tijela PF zgloba su kongruentna.
PF artrotske promjene s reduciranim zglobnim prostorom, manjim izljevom i hondromalacijom IV
stupnja hrskavice interfasetarno.
Hondromalacija II.stupnja lateralnog platoa tibije i hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura. OA promjene obostrano, izraženije lateralno uz osteofite.
Plato tibije interkondilarno straga pokazuje više manjih subhondralnih cista.
Minimalni izljev.
Prednji križni ligament u području distalnog hvatišta pokazuje trokutasti hiperintenzitet koji
može odgovarati manjoj intrasupstancijskoj rupturi.
Vertikalna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska koja seže i zahvaća donju artikulacijsku
plohu uz promijenjen intenzitet signala posteromedijalnog dijela zglobne čahure i meniskotibijalne
sveze - ramp lezija .
Uz stražnju konturu meniska vidi se nekoliko milimetarskih ganglion cista.
Početno degenerativno promijenjen intenizet signala preostalog dijela medijalnog meniska.
Manja ekstruzija dijela diska u meniskotibijalni recesus.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova degeneracije ili rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Blage tendinopatske promjene hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa.
Uredan izgled patelarnog ligamenta.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste.
Report_en:
The articular bodies of the PF joint are congruent.
PF arthrotic changes with reduced joint space, minor effusion and grade IV chondromalacia of the interfacet cartilage.
Grade II chondromalacia of the lateral tibial plateau and the cartilage of the medial femoral condyle. OA changes bilaterally, more pronounced laterally with osteophytes.
The tibial plateau intercondylar posteriorly shows multiple small subchondral cysts.
Minimal effusion.
The anterior cruciate ligament in the region of the distal insertion shows triangular hyperintensity which may correspond to a minor intrasubstance tear.
Vertical tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending to and involving the inferior articular surface with altered signal intensity of the posteromedial portion of the joint capsule and the meniscotibial ligament - ramp lesion.
Along the posterior contour of the meniscus, several millimeter-sized ganglion cysts are seen.
Early degenerative altered signal intensity of the remaining part of the medial meniscus.
Minor extrusion of part of the disc into the meniscotibial recess.
The lateral meniscus shows no signs of degeneration or tear.
The posterior cruciate ligament shows normal signal and is intact in continuity.
The lateral and medial collateral ligaments show normal signal and are intact in continuity.
Mild tendinopathic changes at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon.
Normal appearance of the patellar ligament.
No signs of a popliteal cyst.

Report:
Uznapredovale goanrtrotske promjene uz opsežan zglobni izljev i umjerenu proliferaciju sinovije.
Zone rekonverzijhe koštane srži u metafizi femura.
Denudacija hrskavice medijalnog kompartmenta FT zgloba te fisure i erozije hrskavica lateralnog
kompartmenta.
Hondromalacija III° obje fasete patele i trohleje femura, uz reduciranu debljinu navedenih
hrskavica te opsežne osteofite FP zgloba - opisano u sklopu navedenih OA promjena.
Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Kompleksna ruptura oba meniska uz obostrano ekstruziju oko 5 mm, oba meniska značajno
degenerativno promijenjena.
Potpuna ruptura prednjeg križnog ligamenta.
Stražnji križni ligament u proksimalne 2/3 izrazito edematozan, zadebljan (širine 12 mm), uz
tibijalno hvatište nalazi se više ganglion cisti promjera do 7 mm. - dif. dg. uslijed
uznapredovalih degenerativnih promjena ili parcijalne rupture starijeg datuma.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je vretenasto zadebljan pri hvatištu na lateralni epikondil femura te
promijenjenog intenziteta signala pri hvatištu na glavu fibule, moguće stanje po ranijoj
parcijalnoj rupturi ili uslijed entezopatskih promjena.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je vretenasto zadebljan pri hvatištu na medijalni epikondil femura
uz periligamentarni edem, vjerojatno uslijed entezopatskih promjena.
Tetiva popliteusa edemazotna, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala, u smislu tendinopatije.
Uredan prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su izmijenjenih intenziteta signala na hvatištima za
patelu, održanog kontinuiteta - entezopatske promjene.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Poplitealna cista promjera 5 mm.
Report_en:
Advanced gonarthrotic changes with extensive joint effusion and moderate synovial proliferation.
Zones of bone marrow reconversion in the femoral metaphysis.
Cartilage denudation of the medial compartment of the femorotibial joint and fissures and erosions of the cartilage of the lateral compartment.
Grade III chondromalacia of both patellar facets and the femoral trochlea, with reduced thickness of the aforementioned cartilages and extensive osteophytes of the patellofemoral joint – described as part of the aforementioned OA changes.
The visualized articular surfaces are appropriately congruent.
Complex tear of both menisci with bilateral extrusion of approximately 5 mm, both menisci significantly degenerative.
Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
The posterior cruciate ligament is markedly edematous in its proximal 2/3, thickened (width 12 mm), with multiple ganglion cysts up to 7 mm in diameter at the tibial insertion. – Differential diagnosis: due to advanced degenerative changes or chronic partial tear.
The lateral collateral ligament is fusiformly thickened at its insertion on the lateral femoral epicondyle and shows altered signal intensity at its insertion on the fibular head, possibly representing a prior partial tear or enthesopathic changes.
The medial collateral ligament is fusiformly thickened at its insertion on the medial femoral epicondyle with periligamentous edema, likely due to enthesopathic changes.
The popliteus tendon is edematous with altered signal intensity, consistent with tendinopathy.
Normal appearance of the iliotibial tract and pes anserinus.
The quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament show altered signal intensity at their patellar insertions, with maintained continuity – enthesopathic changes.
The patellar retinacula are intact.
Popliteal cyst measuring 5 mm in diameter.

Report: Técnica: RMN de la rodilla. Resultados: Cambios de señal en el menisco interno sin signos de desgarro. Secuelas de osteocondritis de la tuberosidad tibial. OA femorotibial medial y lateral. OA patelofemoral. Derrame con sinovitis. Quiste subcondral en la meseta tibial lateral. Impresión: Cambios de señal en el menisco interno sin signos de desgarro. OA patelofemoral. Derrame con sinovitis.
Report_en:
Technique: Knee MRI.
Results: Signal changes in the medial meniscus without signs of tear. Sequelae of osteochondritis of the tibial tuberosity. Medial and lateral femorotibial OA. Patellofemoral OA. Effusion with synovitis. Subchondral cyst in the lateral tibial plateau.
Impression: Signal changes in the medial meniscus without signs of tear. Patellofemoral OA. Effusion with synovitis.

Report: Stigmata der Inaktivitätsosteopenie sowie verbliebenes bone bruise im posterolateralen Tibiaplateau nahe der Eminentia bei subchondraler Impression mit teils punktuell chondralen Läsionen. Anamnestisch bek. VKB Ruptur mit wohl ligamentärer Ruptur des anteromedialen Bündels sowie knöchernem Ausriss des posterolateralen Bündels (4/23). Weiteres Ossikel/Flake angrenzend an die nicht sicher abgrenzbare Außenmeniskushinterhornwurzel, hier DD ebenfalls Mitbeteiligung/knöcherner Ausriss. Innenmeniskus mit horizontalem Riss Pars intermedia bis ins Hinterhorn ziehend bei mukoider Vorschädigung. Zusätzlich noch Knochenödem im medialen femorotibialen Gelenkkompartiment randständig, tibial führend, bei vorrangig Chondropathie. Begleitend geringer Gelenkerguss, Reizsynovialitis sowie gering Flüssigkeit gefüllte Baker-Zyste mit CC 3,2 cm. Kl. Plica mediopatellaris.
Report_en: Stigmata of disuse osteopenia as well as residual bone bruise in the posterolateral tibial plateau near the eminence with subchondral impression and partly focal chondral lesions. Historically known ACL rupture with likely ligamentous rupture of the anteromedial bundle as well as bony avulsion of the posterolateral bundle (4/23). Additional ossicle/flake adjacent to the not clearly delineable lateral meniscus posterior horn root, here DD also involvement/bony avulsion. Medial meniscus with horizontal tear extending from the pars intermedia into the posterior horn with mucoid degeneration. Additionally bone edema in the medial femorotibial compartment, marginal, predominantly tibial, with predominantly chondropathy. Accompanying mild joint effusion, reactive synovitis, and mildly fluid-filled Baker's cyst with CC 3.2 cm. Small mediopatellar plica.
